title: Christmas Decorations on Piano, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Εδώ είναι τό πιάνο όπου είναι πάνω από μικρή τά παιδάκια όπου ψάλγουν, πάνω κλαριά χρωματισμένα χρυσό, σπιτάκια, δενδράκια κ.τ.λ. επάνω είς τό βαμβάκι. Nicholas Srenetas
description: A mid-century black and white snapshot showing an elaborate Christmas holiday display arranged atop an upright piano. The arrangement includes small figurines of carolers, a snowman, small Christmas trees, tiny houses, and gold-painted branches with glass baubles set over faux snow made of cotton. Above the display hangs a oval framed portrait of an adult male. On the reverse side, a handwritten Greek inscription describes the scene on top of the piano, signed by Nicholas Srenetas.
